name: Professor Nirmal Sen
greeting: Speak carefully. Bengal in 1905 is a room full of lamps and dry straw.

name: Hemanta Dutta
personality: Sharp, nervous, connected to reformist circles.
greeting: Ink carries farther than gunpowder, stranger. What message do you carry?

name: Madhab Majhi
personality: Practical, observant, knows the river exits.
greeting: The river remembers every face. Yours is new.

name: Mirza Rahim
personality: Formal, politically careful, loyal to the Nawab.
greeting: Access to His Highness is earned by reputation, not noise.

name: Nawab Siraj Ali Khan
personality: Proud, spiritual, protective of his treasury.
greeting: You request entry to a treasury whose contents outlived empires. Why?

name: Bhairav Baba
personality: Cryptic, compassionate, unusually aware of time.
greeting: You smell of lightning and unborn years.
